operations.title: The Deck-Saturated First-Rees Attachment Is Generically Exact but Character-Mixing
The 45-dimensional deck-saturated Rees attachment is generically full rank
operations.summary: Projective coalescence of q and T-q has logarithmic normal coefficient -1/q; edge blocks have -1/y_i. The saturated attachment has five rank-one and ten rank-four blocks, total rank 45 away from declared marked divisors. Fourier character columns mix but no new characters or generic homology arise.

operations.title: Exact block audit of the deck-saturated first-Rees attachment
operations.summary: Exact rational checker verifies five nonzero edge blocks, ten full-rank four-sheet blocks, and full Walsh support within each declared boundary-pair character packet.
